stem:
During a school lunch break, Meena from Tamil Nadu brought lemon rice, Arjun from Punjab brought parathas with curd, and Kuki from Assam brought steamed rice with dal. Their teacher asked why children from different states eat such different traditional foods. Which of the following explanations is correct? ( )
A. Every state grows exactly the same crops, so their foods differ only because of cooking vessels
B. Traditional foods differ because they are based on locally grown crops along with taste preferences, culture and traditions of each region
C. A state's traditional foods decide which crops can grow in that state
D. Everyone in a state eats one fixed traditional food, so differences are only between states

options.text: Every state grows exactly the same crops, so their foods differ only because of cooking vessels
Traditional foods differ because they are based on locally grown crops along with taste preferences, culture and traditions of each region
A state's traditional foods decide which crops can grow in that state
Everyone in a state eats one fixed traditional food, so differences are only between states

teacher.key_rationale: Option B states the correct relationship: locally grown crops together with taste preferences, culture and traditions shape a region's traditional foods. A is false (states grow different crops), C reverses the cause-effect relationship, and D overgeneralises that all people in a state eat the same food.
